title: Timed Listening and Accurate Note-Taking in Academic Settings
prompt: In many university courses, students are expected to listen to spoken information — such as lectures, seminars, or recorded interviews — only once and to record the key points accurately under time pressure. Some educators argue that courses should explicitly train students in timed listening and precise note-taking, while others believe that these skills are best developed by students independently through practice. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on whether universities should formally teach timed listening and accurate note-taking. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类 Task 2 练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先明确题目要求：讨论双方观点（是否应由大学正式教授限时听力与准确记录），并给出你自己的立场。写作时确保每个主体段围绕一个核心观点展开，用具体理由或例子支持，避免只罗列观点。注意题目要求至少 250 词，请合理分配引言、两个主体段和结论的篇幅。
